name: Perindopril
mechanism: ACE inhibition reducing angiotensin II and aldosterone
dosing: Hypertension: start 2-4mg daily and titrate as tolerated
contraindications: Pregnancy, bilateral renal artery stenosis, history of ACE inhibitor-induced angioedema, known hypersensitivity
interactions: NSAIDs may blunt antihypertensive effect and increase renal risk; potassium-sparing diuretics and supplements increase hyperkalaemia risk; lithium levels may rise
monitoring: Check eGFR and serum potassium at baseline and 1–2 weeks after initiation or dose changes; monitor blood pressure response and symptoms of hypotension
pregnancy: Contraindicated in pregnancy; discontinue and seek specialist advice if pregnancy confirmed
sideEffects: Persistent dry cough, hyperkalaemia, hypotension, rare angioedema
clinicalPearls: Effective ACE inhibitor for hypertension and heart failure management; consider alternative (ARB) if cough develops
indication: Hypertension, heart failure and secondary prevention post-myocardial infarction
